title: Abbas Hai Jalaal
body:
ay shaamiyon furaat ko laazim hai chodna
abbas hai jalaal mein rasta na rokna
<<DIVIDER>>
sher e khuda ka sher hai salaar e fauj hai
is ke qadam ko choom ke darya ko auj hai
isko nazar mila ke na taa dayr dekhna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
hyder ki har sifaat ka aeena-daar hai
be-taygh apni zaat mein khuid zulfeqar hai
tum iske saamne kabhi ooncha na bolna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab chaahe cheen sakta hai tum se hayaat ko
ulte misaal e aas ki ye kayenaat ko
maidan mein isay dam e paikaar dekhna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
khath kyanch kar zameen pe lashkar ko rok de
chalte huwe ye maut ke khanjar ko rok de
aata hai isko waqt ke khyber ko todna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
chaahe to ek mashk mein darya utaar le
rukh suye qaimagah samandar ka mod de
aata hai isko sang se pani nichodna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu qalam huwe bhi to ooncha rakha alam
darye se is jari ne hataye nahi qadam
aata nahi dilayr ko maidan chodna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyason ki aas zaamin e chadar hai ye jari
hai wakf e kayenat e wafa iski zindagi
is se kalaam karne se pehle ye sochna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
iske alam pe naad e ali ka hisaar hai
mashkeeza is alam pe wafaon ka haar hai
isko nigaah e saaqi e kausar se dekhna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
<<DIVIDER>>
abbas ki raza hai raza e hussain se
rehaan hukme faatahe badr o hunain se
bekhauf hum ne seekha hai jumla ye bolna
abbas hai jalaal mein...
author: Rehaan Azmi
